title: Amazon's AI Shops While You Sleep
full_monologue: **Amazon's new AI can shop for you while you sleep.** Imagine waking up to a fully stocked fridge, all because an AI analyzed your habits overnight. It’s not sci-fi—it’s real. Amazon’s latest tech uses machine learning to predict what you need, and it places orders automatically. No more running to the store. Just sit back, relax, and let the AI do the work. But here’s the catch: is it really saving you time, or is it just another way for big companies to track you? What do you think? Comment below.
